doc.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Closing question and upcoming Washington jazz party
summary: Asked if anything was missed, she praises the interview and mentions her next trip to a Washington jazz party.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: You’re in the Taj Mahal. Well is there anything I haven’t asked you that I should?
Boy, I think you’ve covered so many topics. There’s an art to interviewing, you’ve covered it.

My next trip is to the State of Washington for the Semi Annual Jazz Party. It used to be, it kind of was a descendent of the Otter Crest, the famous Otter Crest Jazz Party that went on for years and years. And that’s the first week of March.
